1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.Nf3 Bc5 4.c3.strategy: A pawn offer instead of simply retaking: White opens lines for quick development and wants a pawn centre later, and Black is a pawn up without an obvious debt. The compensation is development and open lines rather than anything concrete.
1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.Nf3 Bc5 4.c3.name: Centre Game: Lanc-Arnold Gambit

1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.Nf3 Bc5 4.c3 dxc3.strategy: Takes the pawn and is now two pawns up. White's compensation is development, so Black has to finish developing quickly and give material back before the white pieces coordinate.
